media_urls.description: List of publicly accessible image or video URLs. Maximum 50 items. Supported image extensions — .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp. Supported video extensions — .mp4, .mov, .avi, .mkv, .webm, .wmv.

folder_id.description: Optional media library folder ID to organize uploaded assets. If omitted, assets are placed in the default media library location.
